mapping_options: Preserve prior full-reference D8 STAR parameters exactly. Change output prefix only. No Arriba; no full BAM disk file. Existing index, FASTQs and public controls reused.
disk_measurement_note: Free space changes with macOS caches and other activity; measure again immediately before launch and continuously.

index_original_RNA_contig_dictionary_com.scope: Contig names and lengths match; does not establish sequence equality, identical reference annotations, algorithm equivalence or sample concordance.

capture_contract.frozen_site_set: Exactly 4015 baseline jointly callable SNP coordinates, frozen from completed baseline output before re-alignment outcomes; no adding favorable sites after the rerun.
capture_contract.name_set: Freeze union of discrepancy-supporting query names from all13 baseline exceptions and3 separate MAPQ flags; retain complete source name strings. Include original low-MAPQ support where relevant.
capture_contract.union_not_intersection: Write each emitted STAR record at most once if it overlaps a frozen SNP in an aligned-base or deletion CIGAR block OR its query name belongs to the exception set. Do not use simultaneous -L and -N samtools filters as an OR without validating their semantics.
capture_contract.aligned_base_definition: Use M,=,X and optionally D (recorded explicitly) for site-overlap capture; reference-skip N alone is not base evidence. Qualifying RNA A/C/G/T counts subsequently ignore D/N. Outer alignment span alone overcaptures long introns; if chosen instead, enforce file ceiling.
capture_contract.no_quality_filter_at_capture: Do not filter MAPQ, BQ, duplicates, proper-pair or primary status during capture; downstream primary and sensitivity filters need these records.
capture_contract.full_name_records: For the frozen exception names retain every record emitted by STAR, including mappings elsewhere, secondary/supplementary records and unmapped records. STAR outSAMunmapped Within is retained. Claim complete emitted records, not every possible biological alignment.
capture_contract.mates: Coordinate-captured ordinary SNP reads need not retain off-target mates. Exception-name capture must retain both mates across the full stream; missing names/mates must be reported, never treated as reference allele or biological absence.
capture_contract.name_inventory: Record frozen requested name count, observed requested names/read1/read2/supplementary/unmapped state counts, missing requested names; count total stream records and selected records, and differentiate selection by site/name/both.
capture_contract.site_inventory: Preserve all4015 input sites in the final comparison including zero new coverage; do not recompute joint callability and silently discard losses.
capture_contract.BAM: One compressed selective BAM in the resident output folder; retain all flags/tags/qualities/header from stream. No STAR unsorted BAM on disk, no Arriba tables, no repeated discarded output.

resources.swap: Monitor sysctl vm.swapusage; present allocation5GiB/used~4.13GiB. Avoid parallel heavy compute; sudden OS swap-file expansion can outrun a polling guard. No persistent system settings or other-app shutdown requested.
resources.process_lifecycle: Separate process groups; parent monitors producer/consumer and all children, kills both groups on any error/resource trigger, waits for all exits, keeps partial evidence and explicit failed status. Prevent idle sleep with job-bound caffeinate only.
resources.preflight: Require expected files resident, requested name/site manifests hashed, current free space above planned output+floor+margin, header/control qualification, unchanged STAR parameters.
resources.finalization: Require STAR expected23209264 input pairs and successful completion; consumer exit0; BAM quickcheck; all required logs and selected-name/site counts. If sorting, preflight enough free space for both original and sorted copy plus temporary output above3GiB. Prefer downstream direct scan of selective BAM if duplicate storage fails. Do not delete original BAM/evidence to make space.

limitations: Fixed baseline sites are selected by previous DNA/RNA callability and are not the entire165782-site public universe.
Comparison tests alignment robustness at fixed sites, not sample identity, contamination fraction or diagnostic origin.
Original Caris STAR2.7.8a and new STAR2.7.11b D8 pipelines differ in settings and possibly detailed reference/index construction; no single-factor causal attribution.
Existing compact D1/D8 benchmark demonstrated support changes, so D8 is not equivalent to dense indexing and cannot establish universal sensitivity.
A recovered exception read may have alternative/paralog alignments; MAPQ255 alone is not proof of unique biological origin.
If a resource guard stops the run, preserve partial outputs and classify the comparison incomplete rather than no change.
